text:
maya: ping @sam @jon — onboarding ursa-7b. config.json missing 'generation.max_tokens' (defaults okay?) and tokenizer has 'offset_mode' set to 'legacy' which our runtime maps to 'offset_v1' causing decode mismatch on short prompts. weights pointed at s3://redwood-models/ursa-7b/weights.tar but registry expects a manifest.json. also missing 'vocab_special_tokens' field. can someone quick-check before gate?

sam: on it. can you paste the config.json snippet and the exact weights S3 key?

maya: here's the minimal snippet i grabbed:
```
{
  "model_name": "ursa-7b",
  "tokenizer": { "type": "bpe", "offset_mode": "legacy" },
  "weights": "s3://redwood-models/ursa-7b/weights.tar"
}
```

jon: run the validator locally:
```
config-validator --model-config ./config.json --check-tokenizer --check-weights
```
It'll flag missing manifest + missing vocab_special_tokens.

tasha: note: 'legacy' offset_mode maps to 'offset_v1' which our decoder tolerates for long contexts but fails on short prefix combos. recommend switching to "standard" or adding "compat: true" in metadata. we should also log an upgrade warning when we see legacy.

sam: ok i'll PR a small patch: add "generation.max_tokens": "2048" and "tokenizer": {"offset_mode":"standard","vocab_special_tokens":["<pad>","<unk>"]} and upload manifest.json alongside weights. will add test in config-lint CI.

maya: uploading manifest now, will update thread when upload finishes :white_check_mark:

config-lint-bot: scan results -> ERROR: missing manifest.json; WARNING: tokenizer.offset_mode 'legacy' -> mapped; SUGGESTION: add vocab_special_tokens, set generation.max_tokens. (run `config-validator --fix` to auto-insert defaults)

sam: PR opened -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/482. includes manifest and small migration script.

maya: thanks all. will run a quick smoke serve once CI is green and then un-gate. more followups in PR comments.

maya: closing the loop — CI passed and smoke serve ok. un-gating ursa-7b :tada:
